[Discovery] Daily recommendations cron not running
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The daily discovery recommendations cron job has not completed in the last 24 hours. Users may be seeing stale or missing personalised recommendations.

**Actions:**
1. Check the NestJS scheduler logs for `calculateDailyRecommendations`.
2. Verify the cron expression is configured correctly (EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT).
3. Check if the Supabase connection was available during the scheduled run.
4. Manually trigger the calculation if needed.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Discovery] Partner of the Week cron not running
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The Partner of the Week calculation cron job has not completed in the last 7 days. The weekly spotlight feature may not be updating.

**Actions:**
1. Check the NestJS scheduler logs for `calculatePartnerOfWeek`.
2. Verify the cron expression is configured correctly (Sunday at midnight).
3. Check if no users qualified (correction_ratio > 0.5) and whether seed data is available.
{{/is_alert}}
